model.name: Goals model
model.how: Each team's attack and defence strength from this season and last, newer matches weighing more, plus the home edge. That gives a projected score and the chance of every result.
model.test: Scored on 227 matches this season (five big European leagues and internationals), each predicted only from earlier matches: the model's favourite won 55% (it expected 58%); favourites it rated 60% or better won 79% of 85 (expected 75%); it called over or under 2.5 goals right 61% of the time.
